en.title: FPF Nutrition Product Form Design
en.description: Conducted onsite research in pig farms to identify user pain points and business requirements, then translated findings into PRDs, interactive prototypes, and product solution directions for the nutrition module. Refined information architecture, workflow design, and future AI-agent-oriented capabilities such as smart feed lines, feed demand forecasting, and inventory management.

zh.title: FPF（未来猪场）营养板块新产品形态设计
zh.description:
深入一线猪场开展用户调研，收集并分析业务需求与使用痛点，输出调研报告与 PRD。
基于需求分析结果完成产品方案设计，使用 Figma 输出可交互原型，明确核心流程与功能结构。
协同相关角色推进需求评审与方案优化，持续打磨产品形态。
规划 AI Agent 方向能力，包括智能料线、饲料需求预测与库存管理等方案。

en.title: Emergency Safety Management System
en.description: Led frontend architecture design and delivered 20+ technical documents to standardize development workflows. Built browser-side audio/video conversion with FFmpeg + WebAssembly, supported large-scale real-time sensor visualization, resolved COEP/COOP browser restrictions, and improved observability with Sentry integration.

zh.title: 安全应急管理系统
zh.description:
主导前端架构设计，输出 20+ 开发文档，建立标准化开发流程，极大新人上手效率提升。
基于 FFmpeg + WebAssembly 实现 Web 端音视频编码转换与格式转换。
解决 COEP、COOP 浏览器安全限制问题。
参与着火点算法开发，并通过 ECharts 二次开发实现 10 万级传感器数据实时可视化。

en.title: Operations Tool Platform
en.description: Designed and delivered an enterprise tool platform from 0 to 1 using micro-frontend architecture and Monorepo practices. Improved module reuse by 80%, supported both internal tools and proxied third-party apps, and significantly improved field deployment, testing, and operations efficiency in offline intranet environments.

zh.title: 运维工具集合系统（类 Mac 系统窗口）
zh.description:
从 0 到 1 设计并实现企业级工具平台，采用微前端（Wujie）+ Monorepo，模块复用率提升 80%，支持自研工具与第三方应用接入。
设计定制化组件库，解决不同应用间路由跳转与可拖动布局问题。
在内网无网络环境中显著提升测试、运维与现场实施效率，荣获公司最佳支持奖。

en.title: Emergency Broadcasting WeChat Backend Service
en.description: Independently developed the backend and push-notification system for an emergency broadcasting public account. Improved concurrency with cluster-based multi-process design and used async queue mechanisms to reduce lost requests and improve service stability.

zh.title: 应急广播公众号后端服务
zh.description:
独立完成公众号后端开发。
设计并实现消息推送服务。
基于 cluster 多进程方案优化服务并发能力，TPS 可达 10000+（32 核服务器压力测试）。
通过异步队列机制避免 Node.js 端请求丢失，提升服务稳定性。

en.title: Jingweifang — Precision Feeding & Feed Production Control System
en.description:
Built the digital hub of a mini feed mill for pig farms — a precision feeding and feed-production control system covering both a PC management console and a WeChat mini-program.
As the main frontend developer, led the buildout of core modules and delivered key business flows including production formulas, feeding plans, and device control.
Drove the engineering adoption of AI Coding across the team's R&D workflow, establishing standardized development practices that improved overall delivery efficiency and code quality.
Built the frontend architecture on React + TypeScript, and integrated MQTT for real-time communication and state synchronization with production devices such as smart feed lines.

zh.title: 精喂坊（精准饲喂与饲料生产管控系统）
zh.description:
精喂坊是面向猪场的精准饲喂与饲料生产管控系统，相当于一座小型饲料厂的数字化中枢，覆盖 PC 管理端与小程序端。
作为主要开发者主导前端核心模块搭建，完成生产配方、饲喂计划、设备管控等关键业务链路的设计与落地。
推动 AI Coding 在团队研发流程中工程化落地，建立标准化研发范式，提升团队整体交付效率与代码质量。
基于 React + TypeScript 构建前端架构，通过 MQTT 协议实现与智能料线等生产设备的实时通信与状态联动。

en.title: Personal Site
en.description:
Independently designed and built a full-stack personal site as a pnpm + Turbo monorepo, integrating a public portal, admin panel, file service, login, and resume page across multiple apps with shared workspace packages.
Frontend built on Vue 3 + React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + shadcn/Tailwind v4; shared types, constants, and UI are extracted into reusable workspace packages.
Backend powered by Node.js + Express 5 + TypeORM + MySQL + Redis + JWT, providing business APIs, file conversion (doc/xlsx/markdown), and auth, backed by Jest unit/integration tests and autocannon stress tests.
Continuously integrated and deployed via Docker + PM2 + Nginx + Jenkins, with built-in /live, /ready, /metrics health checks and exception email alerting for observability.

zh.title: 个人站点（全栈平台）
zh.description:
独立设计与开发的全栈个人站点，采用 pnpm + Turbo Monorepo 架构，整合公开门户、后台管理、文件服务、登录等多端应用，并抽取 shared 共享包沉淀类型与 UI 资产。
前端基于 Vue 3 + React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + shadcn/Tailwind v4 构建，多端复用共享类型、常量与组件库。
后端基于 Node.js + Express 5 + TypeORM + MySQL + Redis + JWT，提供业务 API、文件转换（doc/xlsx/markdown）与鉴权能力，配套 Jest 单元/集成测试与 autocannon 压测。
通过 Docker + PM2 + Nginx + Jenkins 实现持续集成与部署，内置 /live、/ready、/metrics 健康检查与异常邮件告警可观测体系。

en.title: Electronic Badge Mini-Program
en.description:
A software and hardware integrated electronic location attendance project for frontline workers, covering both web management and mini program ends, achieving closed-loop management of personnel location and attendance check-in through electronic work cards. 
Lead the development and delivery of the mini program. 
Based on Uniapp and Vue 3, the mini program is implemented, integrating BMap (Baidu Maps) to complete location collection, geofencing, and attendance trajectory visualization.
Collaborate with the web and hardware side for debugging, connect location data upload and attendance rule verification, and ensure the accuracy and real-time attendance of on-site operators

zh.title: 电子工牌小程序
zh.description:
软硬件一体的一线作业人员电子定位考勤项目，覆盖 Web 管理端与小程序端，通过电子工牌实现人员定位与考勤打卡的闭环管理。
主导小程序端的开发与交付。
基于 uniapp + Vue 3 实现小程序端，集成 BMap（百度地图）完成定位采集、地理围栏与考勤轨迹可视化。
协同 Web 端与硬件侧联调，打通定位数据上传与考勤规则校验，保障现场作业人员考勤的准确性与实时性。

en.title: Electronic cash register (private order)
en.description:
This is a supermarket cash register project;
 The front-end is implemented using Electron+Vue 3, and serial port is used to integrate the weighing machine, barcode scanner, and cash register;

zh.title: 电子收银台（私单）
zh.description:
这个一个超市的收银机项目；
前端使用Electron + Vue 3实现，使用serialport 实现称重机、扫码枪、收银机的对接;
